summary: End-to-end ML platforms unify training, fine-tuning, experiment tracking, model registry, and deployment at scale, abstracting away infrastructure for teams building custom or fine-tuned models. You need one when you're training or heavily customizing models, managing many experiments, enforcing governance, or serving models in production with monitoring; if you're simply calling a pre-trained model (e.g., via an LLM API), a managed platform is usually overkill. The market splits between hyperscaler-native suites (SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML), multi-cloud data+ML platforms (Databricks), automated/enterprise AutoML tools (DataRobot, H2O.ai), and specialized MLOps/compute layers (Weights & Biases, Modal).

platforms.name: AWS SageMaker
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute/storage usage; no upfront fee, billed per instance-hour for training, inference endpoints, and notebooks.
platforms.best_for: AWS-native teams developing and deploying custom models end-to-end at scale.

platforms.name: Microsoft Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by Azure compute/storage; no license fee for the service itself, charged for underlying resources.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises in the Microsoft/Azure ecosystem needing governance and integrated MLOps.

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute/node usage, training hours, prediction nodes, and model API tokens.
platforms.best_for: GCP-centric teams wanting highly automated AutoML and direct access to Gemini/foundation models.

platforms.name: Databricks (MLflow + Mosaic AI)
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based by DBU (Databricks Unit) on top of cloud compute; no flat license.
platforms.best_for: Data-centric teams wanting a unified lakehouse plus ML across multiple clouds.

platforms.name: Weights & Biases
platforms.pricing: Free tier for individuals; per-seat/usage subscription for teams and enterprise.
platforms.best_for: ML/research teams needing best-in-class experiment tracking and collaboration layered on any training stack.

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.best_for: Enterprises wanting automated model building with strong governance and limited ML staff.

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.pricing: Open-source core free; enterprise subscription for Driverless AI and H2O AI Cloud.
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting open-source-friendly AutoML with strong interpretability and on-prem options.

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second usage-based pricing for CPU/GPU compute; free starter credits.
platforms.best_for: Developers wanting serverless Python-native GPU compute for training and inference without managing infra.

platforms.name: IBM watsonx
platforms.pricing: Subscription + consumption-based by tokens/compute; enterprise licensing.
platforms.best_for: Regulated enterprises needing governed foundation-model deployment and hybrid-cloud ML.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.pricing: Free tier; Pro subscription and usage-based pricing for Inference Endpoints and compute.
platforms.best_for: Teams building on open models who need a hub for training, sharing, and deploying transformers.

platforms.name: ClearML
platforms.pricing: Open-source core free; tiered SaaS and enterprise subscriptions.
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting an open-source, end-to-end MLOps stack with strong orchestration.
